acceptance: The pypi-publish job in publish.yml succeeds on tagged releases without exchange failures.
Tagged releases publish wheels and sdists to PyPI automatically.
context: Observed during v0.10.0 and v0.10.1 releases: github-release succeeded, but pypi-publish failed with 'Trusted publishing exchange failure'. Past releases (v0.7.2, v0.8.0, v0.9.1) showed the same failure.
description: In .github/workflows/publish.yml, the pypi-publish job has failed on every release since v0.7.2 (including v0.10.0 and v0.10.1) with 'Trusted publishing exchange failure'. The PyPI project 'todo-db' needs the GitHub repository environment / trusted publisher configuration configured on PyPI so tagged releases automatically publish to PyPI alongside GitHub Releases.
